sections.heading: Username colors (MSC4522)
sections.body: Pick how your name looks on dark and light themes. Colors are saved to your Matrix profile as m.color_preference so other MSC4522 clients can see them.
bullets: Separate dark/light theme previews with compact color pickers
Save or remove username colors independently of avatar styling

sections.heading: Home & spaces
sections.body: The Kitsu tab is now your home — direct messages and orphan rooms live together.
bullets: Direct Messages and Rooms sections on the home tab
Add existing rooms to a space from the context menu
Spaces keep their own sidebars on the workspace rail

sections.heading: Desktop updates
sections.body: Kitsu can now check GitHub Releases for new AppImage and Windows builds.
bullets: Automatic update checks in the desktop app
What's new changelog when you launch a new version
CI builds Linux AppImage and Windows installer on every release tag
